🌟 Project Stark - Dandy's World Script 🌟

⚡ AUTO-MINIGAMES - Never miss skill checks again! Automatically completes both horizontal bar & circle minigames with perfect timing ✨

👻 MONSTER ESP - See enemies through walls! Customizable 3D boxes, filled options, distance tracking, RGB colors, adjustable thickness & transparency 🎨

💎 ITEM ESP - Spot all loot instantly! Shows item names + distance with full color customization and auto-scanning 🔍

🔧 GENERATOR ESP - Advanced 3D wireframe boxes (12-edge rendering) with smart proximity tracking & custom colors 📍

✅ Infinite Jump

✅ Infinite Yield Admin
✅ Anti-AFK Protection

✅ Character No-Clip

✅ Custom UI Keybinds

🎮 FULLY CUSTOMIZABLE - RGB color picker, transparency sliders, text size, scan intervals & refresh buttons for everything!

🛡️ ANTI-DETECTION - Built-in hooks & protection systems

Made by Urbanstorm 💜
